title: How I was able to use agentic trading to catch a great win 100% SPY Puts win today
author: VegetableReception34
selftext:
here is my journal for today agentic trading sessions

All times are Eastern, October 22. This is written by the agent

https://i.redd.it/5d80qvtrf1xh1.png

https://i.redd.it/8sx002aek1xh1.png

First trade — 766 put: continuation after the opening selloff.

\- At 9:43, SPY was 766.67, beneath VWAP 766.91 and both EMAs after a heavy-volume breakdown.

\- The agent marked 766.04 as a recent wick low and armed the put beneath it.

\- Pre-entry DOM analysis failed validation, so there was no accepted DOM confirmation before entry.

\- At 9:45:55, the put filled with SPY at 765.98. The recorded option entry premium was $1.78.

\- At 9:48, SPY was 765.64, initially moving in the put’s favor. DOM then reported sellers in control, but that observation arrived after entry.

\- Price subsequently bounced back through VWAP. At 9:56:52, the option stopped at $1.245, a 30.06% loss.



Second trade — 767 put: renewed selling after the rebound failed.

\- After the first stop-out, SPY rebounded above VWAP but could not sustain the recovery.

\- At 10:08, DOM showed Sell Trades 3.36K versus Buy Trades 1.15K at 766.13. That supported selling pressure, although a control flip could not be established from the single snapshot.

\- At 10:11, SPY was 766.34, beneath VWAP 766.62 and EMA-9 766.74, following the failed reclaim.

\- At 10:13, the agent moved the pending put trigger 765.00 → 766.02 to catch renewed selling through its watched level. DOM at this exact decision look failed validation.

\- At 10:14:42, the put filled with SPY at 765.84. The recorded option entry premium was $2.27.

\- The move continued downward. The ladder sold some contracts at +31.50% at 10:22, then some at +52.42% at 10:26, and the final at +103.96% at 10:30.

comments.author: leroylabs
comments.body: The session result needs a contract-weighted calculation. The 766 put lost 30.06%, while the 767 put was scaled out at +31.50%, +52.42%, and +103.96%; without contract counts, option fills, and fees, the final tranche cannot establish a 100% overall win. I’d also flag that the agent raised the trigger from 765.00 to 766.02 even though DOM validation failed at that decision. Was that modification authorized by a fixed VWAP/EMA rule, or was it discretionary model output? No image was available here to reconcile the journal against the broker executions.
